children: Binance Wallet announced on X that users can earn 5 extra Binance Alpha Points by trading on Binance Prediction during a promotion period from 2026-09-23 00:00 to 2026-09-29 23:59 UTC. The campaign applies to users who complete a single Buy trade of more than 50 USDT under the Games tab in the Soccer category on Binance Prediction. Only Buy trades made under the Games tab in the Soccer category will count toward the reward. Each user can receive the reward once only, and users must have a Binance Alpha Points balance greater than 0 on the day the task is completed. Eligible entry points include Binance Prediction on both Web and App. The promotion states that points will be displayed on the next day at 06:00 (UTC), and terms and conditions apply.

The announcement also specifies that the reward is tied only to the listed trading activity and does not apply to other trade types or categories. Users must complete the qualifying Buy trade within the stated promotion window to be eligible for the 5 Binance Alpha Points. The campaign is available through Binance Prediction on Web and App, and the points update timing remains set for 06:00 (UTC) on the following day after task completion.

title: Binance Wallet to Offer 5 Extra Binance Alpha Points for Binance Prediction Soccer Buy Trades
